syllabusTopics: Difference between metals, insulators and semiconductors using band theory
agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank: band theory 5-marker (2023), intrinsic + carriers (2022), elastic-vs-plastic odd one (2022).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on solids

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Three questions: band theory differentiating the three (2023, 5 marks: overlapping bands, ~1 eV gap, 5 eV+ chasm), intrinsic semiconductor plus electrons/holes (2022), elastic-vs-plastic body (2022 odd one out). Gap size decides conductivity.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: metals Eg ~ 0 (overlap) · semiconductors ~1 eV (Si 1.1, Ge 0.7) · insulators 5 eV+ · sigma = n e mu · elastic: recovers shape; plastic: permanent set

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Band pictures assume crystalline periodicity (meaning amorphous solids smear edges). Intrinsic conduction needs kT-scale bridging (absolute zero insulates everything). Doping helps dilute (~1 in 10^6).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Diamond insulates despite pure carbon (9 eV gap). Doping: pentavalent donors (n-type), trivalent acceptors (p-type). Elastic-vs-plastic: recovery vs permanent set under load.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2023 (5): draw three band diagrams (overlap/small gap/huge gap), narrate conduction per case. NEB 2022 (2): intrinsic = pure + thermal pairs; electrons and holes both carry (opposite drift). NEB 2022 (2): elastic recovers, plastic keeps the set.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: quantitative conductivity from qualitative bands; superconductors forced into band logic (Cooper pairs instead); heavy-doping degeneracy ignored.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: N atoms split levels into N sub-levels merging to bands (Pauli); Fermi level placement decides class; thermal tail n proportional to e^(-Eg/2kT) explains thermistors. Doping adds donor/acceptor levels near band edges.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 5-marker: three diagrams plus one line each. n-type pentavalent, p-type trivalent. Elastic recovers, plastic stays.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (5): band theory + three-way split. NEB 2022 (2): intrinsic + carriers. NEB 2022 (2): elastic vs plastic.
